apps.label: YouTube

search_link.note: Used since 1.0; Syed says YouTube works well this way.

notes: Cobalt (web) renderer: the accessibility tree is almost empty, so screens are read from the screenshot.
Selecting a video thumbnail plays it directly (no detail page).
'Latest video of X': search X, open the CHANNEL result (round avatar), go to the Videos tab, play the first tile.

home.looks: Dark UI, left rail of icons (profile, Search magnifier, Home, Shorts, Subscriptions, Library), rows of 16:9 video thumbnails with titles under them.
home.focus: Rail is on the far left; RIGHT goes into the rows. Topic chips row at the top of Home.

search.looks: Text box at the top, an on-screen letter keyboard on the left/bottom, suggestions list, result thumbnails on the right/below.
search.focus: Typing with `input text` works when the search box has focus. After results load, DOWN/RIGHT reaches the result rows; the first result row is videos/channels mixed.

detail.looks: YouTube has no title page for videos: selecting a thumbnail starts playback. Channel pages have tabs: Home, Videos, Shorts, Live, Playlists.
detail.focus: On a channel page, the tab row is near the top; RIGHT to 'Videos', DOWN into the grid, newest first.

player.looks: Full-screen video; overlay with title, seek bar, controls, and 'Skip ad' at the bottom right during ads.
player.focus: During ads, 'Skip' takes focus after ~5 s; OK presses it. BACK exits the player.

apps.label: YouTube Music
notes: Cobalt UI like YouTube. Songs/albums/artists rows; OK on a song plays it.

apps.label: Netflix

title_link.note: /title/<id> opens the title page; /watch/<id> starts playing. Netflix ignores links while running, so it's force-stopped first. Without source=30 it only opens/resumes.

notes: Custom renderer (no Android views): the accessibility tree is empty, read the screen from the screenshot and move with the D-pad.
Profile picker 'Who's watching?' may appear after launch; the last used profile is focused, OK picks it. Sometimes it's skipped.
Left rail: Profile, Search (magnifier), Home, Shows, Movies, Games, New & Popular, My List. It expands when focused.
Title page: Play/Resume is focused first; 'Episodes & more' / season selector below. Episodes list: seasons on the left, episodes on the right.

search.keyboard: grid on the left (a-z, 0-9, space, delete)
search.results: grid to the RIGHT of the keyboard

home.looks: Black UI, red accents. Billboard of one title at the top, rows like 'Continue Watching for <name>', 'My List', 'Trending Now'.
home.focus: Focus on the billboard Play first; DOWN into rows. LEFT from the first tile opens the rail.

search.looks: Keyboard grid on the left with the typed text above it; result posters on the right.
search.focus: Type with `input text`; then RIGHT moves from the keyboard into the results grid (first result top-left).

detail.looks: Title logo, year, maturity, seasons count, synopsis; buttons Play/Resume, Episodes & more, My List, Rate. Backdrop on the right.
detail.focus: Play/Resume focused first. DOWN/RIGHT reaches Episodes & more.

episodes.looks: Seasons listed on the left ('Season 1', 'Season 2'), episodes with thumbnails on the right, numbered.
episodes.focus: UP/DOWN in the season list, RIGHT into episodes, UP/DOWN through episodes, OK plays.

profile.looks: 'Who's watching?' with square avatars and names.
profile.focus: The last used profile is focused; OK.

player.looks: Full-screen; 'Skip Intro' button bottom right during intros; 'Next Episode' near the end.
player.focus: Skip buttons are focused when shown.

ask_user_when: a specific profile is wanted and it isn't the focused one

apps.label: Prime Video

title_link.note: Links are https://app.primevideo.com/detail?gti=... (amazon.com links don't open the app).

notes: Custom renderer: read from the screenshot.
Top navigation bar (not a rail): Search magnifier, Home, Movies, TV shows, Live TV, Subscriptions, My Stuff; DOWN from it into rows.
Title page: 'Resume'/'Watch now'/'Play' first; 'Episodes' and season dropdown below. Rent/Buy buttons mean it is not included - don't press them.
'Watch with ads'/'Watch ad-free' choice may appear; pick the plain watch button, never a purchase.

home.looks: Dark navy UI; top menu bar; hero carousel; rows with blue 'Prime' badges.
home.focus: UP from the first row reaches the top menu; LEFT/RIGHT along it.

detail.looks: Title, IMDb rating, year, buttons row (Resume / Play / Trailer / Watchlist), Episodes tab and 'Season N' dropdown.
detail.focus: Primary button first; DOWN to Episodes; the season dropdown opens a list (UP/DOWN, OK).

apps.label: Crunchyroll
notes: Left rail (Search, Home, My Lists, Browse, Simulcast). Series page: 'Start Watching'/'Continue S1 E3', then season dropdown and episode list.
Sub/Dub variants appear as separate seasons ('Season 1 (English Dub)').
ask_user_when: sub or dub is ambiguous and the user's rule doesn't say

apps.label: Disney+
notes: In India Disney+ content is inside JioHotstar; the standalone Disney+ app is for other regions.

apps.label: Spotify

search_link.note: The TV app only reacts to spotify:search: links (not track/artist links).

notes: Search results: Top result first; OK on a song plays it and queues similar music.

apps.label: Nuvio

title_link.note: Nuvio's DeepLinkParser accepts nuvio://meta?type=movie|series&id=<imdb id>, nuvio://movie/<id>, nuvio://series/<id>, nuvio://tmdb/<type>/<id>.

notes: Kotlin + Jetpack Compose + TV Material 3: the accessibility tree has real text (titles, 'Play', 'Resume S1 E3', 'Season 2').
Stremio-addon based: after Play it may show a STREAM list (sources from addons) unless auto-play first stream is on; pick the first stream.
Sidebar navigation on the left (Home, Search, Library, Addons, Settings); search uses a normal text box with the system keyboard (text can be set directly).

home.looks: Hero backdrop with title, Play, rows of posters ('Continue Watching', catalog rows from addons).
home.focus: Sidebar on the left; rows like Leanback.

detail.looks: Hero with title, buttons 'Play' / 'Resume S1 E2' / 'Next S1 E3', 'Play trailer', 'Mark as watched'; Episodes section with 'Season N' chips.
detail.focus: Play/Resume first; DOWN into Season chips (LEFT/RIGHT), DOWN into episodes (LEFT/RIGHT), OK plays.

stream.looks: List of sources with quality badges (4K, 1080p), size, addon name.

apps.label: Stremio
notes: Web-based UI on TV: partial tree. After choosing an episode a list of streams from addons appears; pick the first.

apps.label: Plex
notes: Left sidebar of libraries; search is in the sidebar.

apps.label: Kodi
notes: Kodi draws everything itself (no tree). Main menu on the left; read from the screenshot.

apps.label: VLC
notes: Leanback browse UI (rows: Video, Audio, Browsing, Playlists). Standard Leanback focus.
